games.name: Paths to Immortality [Ver. 0.6]
games.desc:
Paths to Immortality is an Incremental RPG where your goal is to reach immortality. Join a sect or go solo, cultivate peacefully or battle your way to the top. Reach your goals by harnessing your affinities; incinerate the world with your fire, or destroy all life with a plague. The choice is yours, the paths are endless. 

Update will release sometime this summer, 2025. [Small delay due to personal reasons but it's still coming]
Will have data reset due to a complete rework of the game. Unique Items to people who played before the update releases. 

Game heavily inspired by Theory of Magic and Your Chronicle, check those out.
